description: Überschlägige Kühlleistung (BTU/h) aus Raumfläche und Sonne. — Estimate cooling capacity in BTU/h from room area and sun exposure, using the website's baseline of 340 BTU/h per m². Consider a detailed load calculation for large rooms.
